caption: The drawing depicts a large, earthenware jar with a rounded body that tapers slightly towards the base and narrows at the neck, creating a pronounced shoulder. The jar is rendered in shades of light brown and tan, with subtle darker speckling and shading to suggest texture and volume. Two symmetrical, curved handles are attached on opposite sides near the top of the jar, connecting from just below the rim to the shoulder, and are colored similarly to the body but with slightly darker shading at the attachment points. The jar’s mouth is wide and circular, with the inside of the rim depicted in a deeper brown, indicating depth. The jar stands alone against a plain, off-white background, and is signed “RICHARD BARNETT” near the bottom right corner.
title: Yellow Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
